rules: Queue mirror requests (mirror-first default in URSM P0-1) require only metadata rebuild on restart.
No execution recovery: the request was previously mirrored (not executed).
No result replay: nothing to replay.
On restart, the metadata-only projection is rebuilt from the durable store.
validation_rules: queue_mirror lane MUST NOT initiate upstream work
queue_mirror lane MUST rebuild only metadata (request_id, session_id, model); not attempt_id
